# The system libraries Rust's standard library needs, per host target (design item 18): first as
# `rustc --print native-static-libs` reports them with the pinned toolchain, which cargo.pl checks at every build,
# then those of them the postgres link must add because the C compiler's driver doesn't already link them, which
# meson passes. Adding a library the driver links anyway would change how Postgres' own references bind. The first
# lists are recorded for every target on one machine (a static library needs no linker); the second list is checked
# on each platform's own machine.
aarch64-apple-darwin
x86_64-apple-darwin
